images.title: Join two strips: the exponents add
images.purpose: Shows the product rule as joining a strip of three factors of 2 and a strip of two factors of 2 into one strip of five, 2³ × 2² = 2⁵.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. A before and after comparison: two separate strips on top, one joined strip below, an arrow between.
images.exact_structure: Top row: a strip of 3 equal teal (#0072B2) blocks labelled 2³ above it, a gap, then a strip of 2 equal amber (#E69F00) blocks labelled 2² above it. Blocks carry no text. A small key at the left reads each block = 2. A short downward dark arrow labelled join in the middle. Bottom row: one joined strip of the same 3 teal and 2 amber blocks touching, 5 blocks in all, with a reddish purple (#CC79A7) outline around it, labelled 2⁵ = 32 above it and 3 + 2 = 5 below it. Nothing else.

images.takeaway: Joining strips of the same base adds the counts: 2³ × 2² = 2⁵.
